body:
Released: the boot-splash claim, extended twice (settings persistence, optional key field; then the
visual-language pass).

Product commit 3e9bf2c: splash window opens instantly and narrates the boot as a fog-of-war maze
(spawn/handshake/health/renderer), two-window swap with no dark gap, failures rendered in-window with
restart; `npm run dev` one-command runner (port gate, dual-stack probe, vite-exit guard, joint
teardown) + gated `dev:electron`; settings persisted under userData with the API key value never on
disk (masked session-only field, stripped from artifacts, sidecar pass-through); welcome overlay for
the empty first run; config drawer as overlay sheet; serif/mono typographic hierarchy, flag tones in
row gutters, pane weight by state, one shared hover cursor across ledger/tree/map, birth motion under
prefers-reduced-motion.

Verified: app typecheck clean; renderer suites 44 + 85 passed; sidecar suite 34 passed; vite build
clean; real window launched in dev mode (VITE_DEV) with sidecar spawned and connected.
